subject: t-c-imp
title: T.C.IMP.------DYM.FT.
description: Chart on book p. 122 (ALT(FT)II-16). T-C-IMP (time continuum implications) is the subject; DYM-FT (dynamic functionalism) is the partner. From the subject: INFO-DY, TRS (transition) and EXPM (expansionism). From INFO-DY: RE-DOC (redocumentation). From RE-DOC: STF (source transfer). From TRS: AF-DY (affinity dynamics). From AF-DY: RE-ST (restructuralism). From EXPM: DEC (decentralization). From DEC: FUND-DY (fundamental dynamics).
